0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-2, on a two-game winning streak) host the Toronto Raptors (3-3, on a two-game losing streak), with Denver 8th in the West and Toronto 5th in the East. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
